crossRefs.note: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison.…
The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less…
But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be…
For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated…
James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea, and all you who…
“Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs…
“Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to…
He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia…
“Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

people.name: James

translations.web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
